title: THE LONG WAY BACK · title page
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. He doesn't recognize himself. The reader does.

panels.composition: An opened highway map filling the page, its creases drawn, the coast a blue line and 101 a red one with twenty-two small dots along it and eight of them ringed, the title lettered across the folds; in the legend box the subtitle; on the map's corner a motel key tag with a room number as a shape and the Datsun's key.

image.prompt: watercolor comic page in road grays with one color, an opened highway map filling the page with its creases drawn, a coastline in blue and a highway in red with twenty-two small dots and eight of them ringed, the title hand-lettered across the folds, a motel key tag and a car key lying on the map's corner
image.notes: Twenty-two stops; the book takes eight. The rings are the eight.

lettering: He doesn't recognize himself. The reader does.

art.line: brush-pen; the sabbatical hand, unsteady in the first stops and not by the last
art.palette: watercolor; the road's grays, one color per stop
art.paper: Arches, ruled for tiers and then not
